title: The Dog Night, 2008
logline: Nine years. The bulb replaced. Someone replaced it. The strip wonders who, silently.

panels.composition: The dumpster. A new bulb, bright, a brighter white than the old. WOOD and BARNABY. Wood looking at the bulb.

image.prompt: a young man and a gray-muzzled dog behind a bowling alley at night under a brand-new bright white bulb, the man looking up at it, muddy watercolor, no words

panels.composition: The bulb. New. A fingerprint on it.

image.prompt: close-up of a new bare bulb with a single fingerprint on its glass, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting. The dog leaning. Both lit hard white now, no pink.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on gravel with a dog leaning against him under hard white bulb light, no words

panels.composition: Walking away. The sign. All lit.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking away under a fully lit bowling-alley neon sign, watercolor, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: Someone replaced the bulb. Gully, the reader assumes. The strip never says.
